subject: RE: Festive Sale - funding
body:
Hi team,

Thanks for the Festive Sale slot. We can fund 50% of the markdown on the Barkley range, provided you guarantee a top-3 banner and the range sells 3,400 units between 6th and 12th Nov. If the target is missed the funding lapses.

Regards
Anil Rao
Barkley Foods

subject: Festive sale - Purrline support
body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

For the Festive Sale Purrline will fund 30% of the markdown on every Purrline SKU you put on promo. No other conditions. We will send the credit note after the event.

Thanks & regards
Rakesh Shah
Purrline Nutrition LLP

subject: RE: Festive Sale funding ask
body:
Hello,

NutriPaws can support 35% of the discount cost across our range if the range sells 1,150 units during 6-12 Nov. Happy to review after the event.

Best
Meera Iyer

subject: RE: Festive Sale - funding
body:
Hi,

Sorry, margins are very thin this quarter and we are not able to fund any discount for the Festive Sale. We will keep stock ready as usual.

Sanjay
Litterly Products

subject: Groomwell festive support
body:
Hi team,

Groomwell will fund 25% of the markdown on GW-01 and GW-03 for the Festive Sale if you give us a top-3 banner placement. No sales target from our side.

Regards
Neha Bhatt
Groomwell Care

subject: RE: Festive sale, TW-01 and TW-02
body:
Dear team,

We can fund 40% of the markdown on TW-01 and TW-02. Please note our lead time is 14 days, so we cannot ship fresh stock before the sale starts.

Vikram Sethi
Tailwind Play Co

subject: Payday sale
body:
Dear team,

For the Payday Sale we can fund 20% of the markdown, nothing more this month.

Rakesh Shah
Purrline Nutrition LLP
